notes.title: Christmas Event 2020
notes.content:
[h1]Christmas Changes[/h1]

- Crates changed to presents
- Holiday hats on players and zombies
- Other small temporary visual changes

[h1]Version 1.2.0[/h1]

The Christmas event is paired with version 1.2.0 which includes 3 new weapons

- Synth Revolver
- Ice Wand
- Ice Laser gun


Happy Holidays!

notes.title: Halloween Event 2020
notes.content:
[h1]Halloween Visual Changes[/h1]

- Main menu background changed
- All levels include pumpkins and graves
- Zombies and baby zombies have pumpkin heads
- Bulky zombies and bosses are ghostlike

[h2]New Permanent Weapon[/h2]

- A spooky new scythe weapon with a primary swing attack and secondary attack shooting a ghostly pumpkin.


Happy Halloween!

notes.title: Version 1.1.1
notes.content:
[b]-- Additions --[/b]

- Added various other resolution sizes

[b]-- Changes --[/b]

- Made blowguns dart smaller
- Chakram Guns durability reduced and bullet damage increased.
- Buffed Magneto Gun
- Fixed crashing issues related to resolution change

notes.title: Version 1.1.0
notes.content:
Version 1.1.0

[h1]Additions[/h1]

- Added Chakram Gun
- Added Dual Sword
- Added Cannon Hat
- Added Blow Dart
- Added Secondary Attack Control for specific weapons
- Added Secondary Attack for simple pistol and triple shot pistol

[h1]Changes[/h1]

- Changed Drop Keybind for Keyboard to F
- Made sprint toggleable instead of "hold-to-run"
- Buffed Fire Wand
- Buffed Simple Sword

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content: - Fixed Magneto Gun hitting the player that shot it
